info.description: API collection for the economizai backend (NFC-e collaborative price intelligence). Maintain in sync with every endpoint change. The 'E2E Flow' folder runs all requests in logical order — each request seeds variables for the next.

item.description: K-anonymity-protected aggregates. Will return empty until enough households contribute.

item.name: Deals — Ofertas pra você (watched markets only)
Markets
item.description: Market catalogue (visited + watched + nearby) and the user's watchlist of CNPJs to monitor regardless of distance.

item.name: Price Alerts
item.description: User price-drop alerts ('avise-me quando'). A rule fires when any household's confirmed receipt contributes an observation at or below the threshold (optionally within radiusKm of home). Delivers a PRICE_DROP notification to the inbox + push. One rule per (user, product) — re-posting updates it.

item.name: Notification Rules
item.description: Unified notification rules — create user rules (PRICE_DROP, STOCKOUT/replenishment, BUDGET) and enable/disable any rule including the auto-seeded system defaults (PROMO_PERSONAL, PROMO_COMMUNITY, CHEAPER_MARKET, DIGEST). GET returns user rules + defaults as toggles. PATCH toggles 'active' (and for CHEAPER_MARKET, set radiusKm to also include markets near home in addition to your watched markets). The legacy /api/v1/alerts folder is a thin alias over PRICE_DROP rules.

item.name: Items
item.description: Purchased line items flattened across all receipts. Item-level companion to Receipts (receipt rows) and Insights (aggregates). Same filter vocabulary as /insights/query — every filter optional, multi-value filters OR internally. CONFIRMED purchases only, newest first, paginated.

item.name: List items by category (HOUSEHOLD lens — effective category, default)

query.description: Default. Effective category: excludes products moved to a custom category or another enum.

item.name: List items by category (GLOBAL lens — global Product.category)

query.description: Ignore household overrides; filter by global Product.category (pre-lens behavior).

item.name: Categories
item.description: Household custom categories + product migration. All household-scoped: the global product/catalog is never mutated. GET lists the 9 global enums (id=null, custom=false) plus the household's custom ones. Migrate moves selected products into exactly one target (a global enum OR a custom category).

item.name: List items in a custom category
Consumption (Phase 3)
item.description: Predictive purchase intelligence per household — when products will run out, suggested shopping list. Volume-gated: products with fewer than 2 prior purchases are silently skipped.

Shopping list (PRO-52)
item.description: Multi-market basket optimization. Greedy heuristic — for each item picks the cheapest known market (local history first, community index fallback), then groups items per market.

item.name: Shopping lists (persistent)
item.description: Real per-household shopping lists — build, edit, check off as you shop. Items can reference a canonical Product OR be free text.

item.name: Notifications (inbox)
item.description: User-facing inbox for notifications generated by the app (promo alerts, etc).

item.name: Webhooks (billing)

request.description: Provider-agnostic billing webhook. Grants PRO. Public route; verified by X-Webhook-Secret against economizai.billing.webhook-secret (empty in dev = check skipped; wrong/missing when set = 401). A real provider (Stripe/Mercado Pago) maps its webhook onto this shape.
Provider-agnostic billing webhook. Cancels the subscription and drops the user to FREE. See ACTIVATE for secret handling.

RevenueCat billing webhook (Apple StoreKit + Google Play unified). Public route; authenticated by the fixed Authorization header configured in the RevenueCat dashboard, checked against economizai.billing.revenuecat.auth-header (fail-closed: unset config = every call 401). app_user_id is our user UUID (or email). Always 200 for accepted calls.

item.description: Server-to-server billing webhook seam. Not called by the FE — a payment provider posts here on subscription lifecycle events.

item.name: Reparse a receipt from stored raw HTML (admin)

request.description: Re-runs parsing on the stored raw HTML. Replaces existing items, resets status to PENDING_CONFIRMATION so the owner can re-confirm. Use after parser fixes. 400 if raw_html is missing.

item.name: List users (admin, paginated, optional name/email search)

request.description: Substring on email + name (case-insensitive). Sort defaults to createdAt desc.
User profile + householdId + member count + receipt counts by status + 30-day spend.
Delete a user account + all its data (test/garbage cleanup). 204 No Content; 400 for ADMIN accounts (demote first).
Set a user's subscription tier to PRO (testing/promos/ops). Activates a manual subscription. Returns the admin user detail. ADMIN-only.
Set a user's subscription tier to FREE (cancels the subscription). Returns the admin user detail. ADMIN-only.
Same content-search semantics as GET /receipts but cross-household. Includes FAILED_PARSE rows for parser triage.

item.name: Get receipt by id (admin override of household ownership check)

request.description: Resolves the user by email and dispatches a notification through NotificationService — useful for verifying push/SMTP wiring on demand. Returns 202 even if the channel is stubbed; check the notifications inbox or device to confirm delivery.

Validation report for the DISMISSED/MUTED relevance filter (SHADOW -> ON decision). engagement = volume + tapThroughRate/dismissalRate; suppression.regretEngagements = taps/adds/conversions the filter would have prevented (near-zero = safe to turn ON). regretSavings = R$ of conversions it would have blocked.

Paid-API spend report (captcha + Infosimples): total cost/calls over the window, plus breakdown byService and byState, and today's spend vs the global daily budget. Reads the paid_api_call ledger. ADMIN only.

Per-UF ingestion coverage: mode (VERIFIED = dedicated adapter / EXPERIMENTAL = QR-portal+Infosimples fallback chain / UNSUPPORTED = chain disabled), attempts/successes/failures per chain layer from real users' scans, and lastAttemptAt. The data for deciding which state adapter to build next. ADMIN only.
Full canonical catalog, paginated. Page<ProductResponse>. ADMIN-only.
Paginated list of products with brand=null. Each entry includes up to 5 sample raw descriptions from its aliases — gives the curator enough context to assign a brand.
Lightweight admin PATCH that sets only the brand on a product. Returns the updated ProductResponse. Use after listing missing-brand products to fill in catalog gaps.
Groups of products sharing the same (genericName, brand, packSize, packUnit) profile — likely duplicates. Within each group, oldest product first.
Returns per-table migration counts WITHOUT applying. Sanity-check the numbers, then re-run with dryRun=false to apply.

APPLIES the merge. Migrates aliases, receipt items, price observations, manual purchases, shopping-list items, household aliases and consumption snoozes from absorbed → survivor, then deletes absorbed. NO undo.
Re-runs brand extraction over the catalog and fills products missing a brand (never overwrites). Run after adding entries to brand-registry.csv.

Merchants scanned by real users but outside every supported segment (OTHER/UNKNOWN, no override), ranked by scan volume. Their receipts are ingested for the user but held out of the collaborative price index until a verdict.

Verdict on a grey merchant. SUPPORTED promotes it into the collaborative index (backfilling observations from its already-confirmed receipts); BLOCKED rejects future scans with a localized 400/failed-parse; null clears the override back to segment-driven gating.

query.description: true to detach confirmed-purchase items and delete anyway

request.description: Read-only: re-runs the categorizer over every product and lists where the stored category differs from the freshly extracted one. Preview before POSTing to apply.

APPLIES re-categorization. By default only trusted dictionary suggestions are applied (ML is currently unreliable); skips manual (source=USER) categories and null suggestions. Pass includeMl=true to also apply ML. Run the dictionary fixes first, then this.
